title: Actor Identity
description: Shared actor identity model used by both advisory and enforcement layers.

actor_id.description: Stable identifier for the actor within a coordination scope. Must be stable for the duration of the actor's participation.

actor_kind.description: Classification of actor origin. 'agent': in-process AI agent. 'operator': human operator. 'remote_agent': agent from another process via HTTP/MCP. 'mcp_client': MCP protocol client. 'http_client': generic HTTP caller. 'system': substrate-internal process.
